# 0.9.0-alpha03

> **Alpha, checked on an emulator only.** Unit tests pass on both flavours. Watch order, the list editor and the calendar chip were looked at on an emulator; the rest of this build has not been on a real phone. The new list sync has not written to a real account yet, and the player changes were not played back. Expect bugs and report them on GitHub.
>
> Version `0.9.0-alpha03` (`1900003`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates alpha02 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Sync lists between AniList and MyAnimeList (Settings > Tracking > Sync lists)
    - Pick which way to copy, see every difference with its cover, untick what you want to keep, then update
    - Optional daily sync in the background
  - Watch order redone
    - Hand-written orders from the community for big franchises, kept for a day and used offline; other shows use the previous source
    - Several orders (airing, novel, chronological) behind a chip under the title, the same one the calendar uses
    - A numbered line for the main story; side stories and extras are smaller rows marked optional, and the eye button hides them
    - Recap films sit under the season they retell as "Alternative to N", including ones the order itself leaves out
    - Titles in your AniList title language; what you finished is greyed and says Completed; unreleased entries say Coming soon or the date
    - While it loads, placeholder rows shaped like the real ones
  - Openings & endings moved from the anime home top bar to the profile menu

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Episodes without a title from the source were named "Episode 1.0"
  - Playback speed read "2.00x" / "1.50x"; now 2x / 1.5x
  - Long-press on the player settings button opened a hidden gestures sheet; removed
  - List editor: the +1 box was not as tall as the progress field
  - Watch order said "No Watch Order Found" when the order site was busy; it now says it could not load
  - Calendar: the day strip holds its place while the week loads; the filter chip uses the app font
  - Icon buttons on extension and repository rows have a ripple that stays inside the button
  - TV banner redrawn with the current mark
